requirement.description: The Design class is missing the _assign_names_to_signals method that is called during initialization. Tests fail with AttributeError: 'Design' object has no attribute '_assign_names_to_signals'.
requirement.contract: Add the missing _assign_names_to_signals method to the Design class that properly assigns names to signals within a fragment, similar to the existing _assign_names_to_fragments method.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_hdl_ir.py::ConflictTestCase::test_domain_conflict, tests/test_hdl_ir.py::RhsTestCase::test_slice, tests/test_hdl_ir.py::InstanceTestCase::test_nir_simple, and all other tests with the same error pattern.

requirement.description: Several tests in test_lib_data.py are failing due to TypeError when trying to interpret StructLayout as an integer. These relate to Const construction and attribute access validation.
requirement.contract: Fix the Const class constructor and attribute access validation to properly handle StructLayout objects and prevent incorrect interpretation as integers.

requirement.description: Tests in test_hdl_ast.py are failing due to missing error handling for IOValue operations and incorrect type checking.
requirement.contract: Implement proper error handling for IOValue operations and fix type checking for IO ports in IOValueTestCase.

requirement.description: Tests in test_lib_io.py are failing due to IO port construction and validation errors, including wrong direction handling and conversion issues.
requirement.contract: Fix IO port construction and validation logic to properly handle port directions and conversions.

requirement.description: Tests in test_lib_wiring.py are failing due to signature flattening and representation issues.
requirement.contract: Fix signature flattening logic and representation to correctly handle signal directions.
